metadata.title: Daniel Marcos Ferreira — Tech Lead & Full-Stack Engineer
metadata.description: Editorial portfolio — Tech lead and full-stack delivery (TypeScript, React, Node). Based in the Biella region, Italy; open to remote-first EU teams.

hero.byline: Daniel Marcos Ferreira — Biella Region, Italy
hero.titleAccent: from civil foundations to product systems.
hero.intro: I combine a civil engineering background with Information Systems study and hands-on delivery: leading features across React and Node, tightening API contracts, and keeping releases traceable. Goal: high-impact roles where I own technical direction end to end.
spotlightBullets: Owns delivery across web clients, services, and persistence layers.
Aligns stakeholders on scope, quality gates, and incremental releases.
Comfortable with Firebase, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB depending on the product surface.
hero.spotlightTech: Stack: TypeScript · React · Next.js · Node.js · NestJS · PostgreSQL · Firebase · REST

work.title: Recent employers, same bar for craft.
work.lede: Three concurrent and sequential roles from my CV — each card mirrors date range, title, and the technologies I used on the ground.

experience.title: Civil degree, systems focus, tech lead track.
experience.lede: A civil engineering foundation (UBM), a full-stack bootcamp (Driven), and ongoing Information Systems study (Estácio) sit alongside delivery at FIGTREE, NOVWARE, and ORBWARE — precision and traceability carried from structures into software.

degree_information_systems.title: Information Systems (undergraduate)

degree_civil_engineering.title: Civil Engineering (undergraduate)
degree_civil_engineering.description: Structural mechanics, materials, and coordination disciplines that still inform how I design systems under load and ambiguity.

job_figtree.title: Tech Lead / Full-Stack Engineer
job_figtree.description: Primary product engagement: shaping features, reviewing technical direction, and shipping across the stack.
bullets: Leads implementation of customer-facing modules and internal tools with clear ownership of quality and deadlines.
Defines and evolves REST contracts between Next.js/React clients and NestJS services.
Pairs with stakeholders to translate business rules into testable increments and observability-friendly backends.
job_figtree.techLine: Technologies: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Firebase, REST APIs.

job_novware.title: Full-Stack Engineer
job_novware.description: Building and maintaining web products with emphasis on TypeScript-first codebases and predictable API behavior.
bullets: Delivers React interfaces with attention to accessibility, performance, and maintainable state boundaries.
Implements and extends Node/NestJS services with schema-aware validation and structured logging.
Collaborates in agile ceremonies with clear communication of trade-offs and delivery risk.
job_novware.techLine: Technologies: React, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, MongoDB, REST APIs.

job_orbware.title: Full-Stack Engineer
job_orbware.description: Short-cycle contribution to product surfaces and integrations during a focused engagement window.
bullets: Shipped React features against existing design systems and API conventions.
Integrated third-party services and hardened error paths for production traffic.
Documented handover notes for the core team to reduce continuity risk.
job_orbware.techLine: Technologies: React, TypeScript, Next.js, REST APIs.
